column1: # Black/Matrix AD - Chapter 1 seasonal events: Prague
# No manual wrapping: patchline.py supplies pixel-aware line breaks.

column2: It should be about time for my favorite cherry blossoms to start blooming...
But I wonder why...
When cherry blossoms fall, I feel lonely... almost wistful...
If you go to the fields now...
You may find sweet potato flowers that look just like morning glories...
They scarcely bloom unless the weather stays warm—phantom flowers, really...
It is nearly chrysanthemum season...
Cosmos and daisies are chrysanthemums too, essentially...
Today I saw a winter camellia blooming...
But I wonder why...
When camellia flowers fall, I feel sad...
Spring dawn... Hmph! You wouldn't understand even if I told you!
Good morning. Where is your answer? Hmph! Do your $$リハビリ$$ properly today too!
Good morning. It will be hot again, so get your work done efficiently...
Understood!?
Gooood morning...
It was so stifling yesterday that I couldn't sleep properly...!
Are you even listening?
At last it's getting cooler! What a lovely season...
D-Don't imagine I was talking to you!
It will get cold soon... Start preparing for winter!
Got it? That's an order from me!!
It looks like it may snow today...
Hmph! Listen: you stay quietly inside the house!
If you caught another $$風邪$$, I'd be the one suffering...!
Uuuugh... It's s-so cold...
I can't possibly feel like working outside...!
You stay quietly inside today too...
Honestly, it's hot again today.
I'm going to $$水浴び$$ now, so you're coming with me...
Hmph! Don't tell me you're going to say no!
Let's $$水浴び$$!
No!!
A-$$台風$$! Fix the leak quickly!!
Don't tell me you overdid yourself and collapsed again?
Working so hard even though you're just recovering...
But... you were a help, with you here...
You're useful now and then...
I'd have stayed cold forever if I were alone!
Idiot! I'm fine...
Worry about yourself, not me!
As long as you are with me...
I'm warm...
Pant... pant... I-I feel a little feverish...
But don't you dare go gather $$薬草$$ on your own just because of it...
I won't let you get away with it...
I'm fine now, but you stayed by my side all night, didn't you?
Thanks to you, I couldn't sleep!
I'm not as dull as you; of course I noticed...
(Idiot...!)
You were a help yesterday...
H-Hmph! Even I can say thank you!
Even you must remember what day today is, surely~!?
...Fine, whatever!
Here. (Happy $$誕生日$$...!!)
Say...! I thought up a totally new, never-before-seen $$お仕置き$$...!
Ta-daaaa~!!
Well? Would you care to try it?
Pant... pant... I-I can't breathe...
Where? You think I'd tell you so you could fix it!?
Pant... pant... Hmph! I feel sick, can't you see!?
$$プラハ$$ is gone!!
Hmph! So you can finally move around. This week was a bother!
B-But don't tell me you've been overdoing it~?
If you collapse again, you'll only be more trouble!
It seems... you're all right.
Come to think of it, there is one important thing!
This is important, so don't ever forget it!
You've lost your $$記憶$$ of this $$世界$$,
and you are not used to this $$世界$$'s common sense.
So until I can feel safe sending you out of the house...
You will not leave the fence around the house without my permission!!
Understand!? If you sneak out, I won't let you off lightly!
For a while... stay here and do your $$リハビリ$$!!
Hey!
Of course you remember what day today is, don't you~!?
